itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-19 wave B2 utah, chunk r10_02)

contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' = 2931.22 on the p3 Summary Page, equal to the printed 'Total' at the foot of the RIGHT-hand table of the filer's own ledger (2931.22)
contributions.detail: The 15 entries of the right-hand 'Name / Amount' table sum to 103.48 + 77.74 + 25 + 100 + 25 + 300 + 500 + 200 + 500 + 300 + 200 + 100 + 200 + 200 + 100 = 2,931.22 exactly = the filer's own printed Total = the promoted PER-PERIOD cell Box B. A crop of the whole strip between the last entry and that total renders BLANK, so the 2,931.22 is the table's own total and not a sixteenth entry (the §H4 test on a gridless ledger). Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints 54,500.27 and is CUMULATIVE - never summed as an increment; it carries the whole cycle, which this seven-days-pre-General report does not itemize. The summary ladder closes on its own terms: A 2456.32 + B 2931.22 = F 5387.54, and F - D = 149.93 = the printed Balance at Close.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' = 5237.61 on the p3 Summary Page, equal to the printed 'Total' at the foot of the LEFT-hand table of the filer's own ledger (5237.61)
expenditures.detail: The 9 entries of the left-hand 'Who / Amount' table sum to 3.48 + 2.74 + 1.21 + 3.38 + 29.47 + 1300 + 3350 + 500 + 47.33 = 5,237.61 exactly = the filer's own printed Total = the promoted PER-PERIOD cell Box D. The control strip between the last entry and that total renders BLANK. Box E (YTD) prints 54,450.34 and is never summed as an increment.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only closed on both sides, and both conventions were tested. The filer's own ledger has no in-kind column and marks no line in-kind; the v. 4.20 summary page has no in-kind line; and no offsetting contribution/expenditure pair of identical amount appears. Monetary-only gives 2,931.22 = Box B and 5,237.61 = Box D exactly, so adding in-kind would add nothing. Tested afresh on this filing and NOT carried over from this filer's April report.
itemized.escalation_note: 7 crops at 600 dpi, all named fb431edc_*. LEFT table: row 1 rendered '3.48' and row 9 (the last entry) rendered '47.33'. RIGHT table: row 1 rendered '103.48', row 13 - the CONTINUATION-LINE entry - rendered '200' on the line carrying 'Construction', and row 15 (the last) rendered '100'. Because this sheet has NO PRINTED GRID, the row-index traps were screened with a TALL CONTROL STRIP per table covering everything between the last entry and the printed Total: both rendered blank white down to the total itself ('5237.61' and '2931.22'). So no line continues below the last entry, no line holds two entries, and each trailing figure is a total rather than an entry. The two tables were measured SEPARATELY with rowbands.py --text-lines --col (28,42 for the left, 66,82 for the right) rather than sharing one band list, because a band measured in one column does not transfer across a sheet with skew.

geometry.provenance: printed-rule detection on the rendered page (scripts/campaign_finance/rowbands.py, raw-render frame): per-page frame = the Amount column band x one measured band per printed table row; a row's box is their intersection, in pct of the page as poppler renders it (rotation included)

itemized.notes: A 3-PAGE FILING WITH NO COUNTY SCHEDULE A/B SHEET, and that is NOT a `no-schedule-page` state: p1 COVER (v. 4.20 footer; Office box prints 'Utah County Attorney'; the ONLY marked report-type option is 'Seven days preceding the General Election', though its fill renders as a partial crescent rather than a solid dot - it is the only mark on the list and the index label 'General' agrees; signed and dated Nov 1, 2022), p2 THE FILER'S OWN TYPED LEDGER, and p3 SUMMARY PAGE (boxes A/B/C/D/E/F + an UNLETTERED close box, the v. 4.20 signature). What is missing is the county's FORM, not the filer's entries, so both sides are `transcribed`. ⚠ THE LEDGER PUTS BOTH SIDES SIDE BY SIDE ON ONE PORTRAIT SHEET, in TWO INDEPENDENT COLUMN-PAIRS: a LEFT table headed 'Who / Amount' with its own printed 'Total 5237.61', and a RIGHT table headed 'Name / Amount' with its own printed total 2931.22, the two totals sitting on nearly the same line. There is no 'Contributions' or 'Expenditures' title on the sheet at all, so the sides were assigned by CONTENT and confirmed by the summary: the left table's payees are Paypal, Venmo, BIVIO, BCR, Facebook and Blip - processors and vendors - and its total equals Box D; the right table's entries are named individuals, a couple, and three companies, and its total equals Box B. This is the portrait analogue of the documented landscape two-table ledger, and each table needed its OWN measured bands. NOTE FOR CONTRAST, NOT FOR INFERENCE: this filer's own April filing and the two Gordon filings in the same chunk use the same 'Who' / 'Name' column vocabulary, and in ONE of them (Gordon 4/4/22) the summary boxes are crossed relative to the sheets. Here they are NOT crossed - each table's total lands on the box its content implies - and that was established from this document alone. THE LEDGER PRINTS NO DATE COLUMN AND NO ADDRESS COLUMN, so all 24 rows carry needs_review=1 with an absent date, and every donor_city/donor_state is blank because the field does not exist. Amounts are printed inconsistently and kept verbatim: whole numbers with no decimal point (25, 100, 1300, 3350, 500) alongside two-decimal figures (3.48, 77.74, 47.33); nothing is ambiguous, because each table's own Total closes exactly on the reading recorded. NO CHECKLIST is bound to this filing (2 of the 8 filings in this chunk carry none, both of them November filings), and the cover's Page box is left blank, so the document is unfoliated and no sheet can be shown missing; pdfinfo counts 3 pages and all 3 were read. THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS WHOLLY UNANSWERED - neither radio filled - an honest blank, never read as 'No'. PRIVACY: this filing is NOT named `_Redacted`, yet the county blacked out the cover's Address block AND the Signature block on it - a filename is not evidence of redaction in either direction. The cover's phone and email print in the clear and are not carried. There are no donor addresses to redact, the ledger having no address field. PAGE-FACE NAME 'Jeff Gray' matches index.csv; page-face office 'Utah County Attorney'.
